title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Once the Ishraq time starts, is it permissible to pray Chasht salah after Ishraq salah? 7535 views Q. Witr Prayer 13097 views Q. I have some questions, plz help me in them.. 1. When a person is travelling, he has to offer namaaz e Qasr.. What is the minimum distance of the journey after which he can be able to offer qasr.? If one gets to offer namaaz with jamaat while travelling, what shud he do.? And if he has already offered qasr namaaz and later sees that the namaaz is starting with jamaat, what shud he do.? 2. In the tashahud of the 2nd rakaat of every 4 rakaat namaaz, we have to read Attahayat and soon after Ashaduallah.... we have to get up for the 3rd rakaat without reading darood.. Why is it so that we shud not read darood here.? And take for example we join the jamaat in the 3rd rakaat, in the 4th rakaat's tashahud of jamaat, it will be our 2nd rakaat.. So in this, while everyone is reading atahayat, darood and dua, shud we also read the complete or we shud stop at ashaduallah.... ? 3. In fajr, after offering faraz namaaz we shud not offer any namaaz or sajda till ishrakh.. Is it the same in asar.? Or can we offer any nafil namaaz or do sajdas till 15 mins prior to magrib namaaz.? 15056 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 40231 Country: India Title: How do I get rid of waswasa in salah Question: Please help me to get rid from wasawis in salah and also how do I get rid from hasad, keena and consider myself best from all. Please help me I heard in bayan that Allah said in the holy Quran that only pious heart [qalb saleem] will enter in jannah and I do not have that heart. Please help me, hell is extremely bad. Answer ID: 40231 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 631/612/N=1433) You should establish spiritual contact with any Shaikh who is following sunnah and Shariah. Then as per his guidance, try to remove bad morals like jealousy, malice and enmity etc and bring good morals inside you such as patience, gratitude, contentment and hospitality etc in real sense of the term. In-shaAllah, you shall be blessed with pious heart. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
